Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – Marginal BEAT; EBITDA – Inline; PAT – Inline Changes in Estimates Post Q2FY27 Result FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 0%/0%; EBITDA: 0%/0%; PAT : 0%/0% Recommendation Rationale • Volume-led Growth & Market Share Gains: Cera delivered strong revenue growth of 27.4% YoY to Rs 603 Cr in Q2FY27, driven by 16.6% volume growth, 9.1% pricing impact and 1.7% favourable mix.
Sanitaryware and faucetware revenues grew 24% and 38%, respectively, reflecting healthy demand across product categories.
Retail demand is showing a meaningful recovery, contributing 61% of revenues, while projects continue to provide stable growth.

Current Valuation: 26x FY28E EPS (Earlier Valuation: 29x FY28E EPS) Current TP: Rs 6,100/share (Earlier TP: Rs 7,000/share) Recommendation: We reduce our EPS multiple to account for uncertainty in raw material prices, ongoing geopolitical situations and market sentiments to 26x FY28E EPS.
Consequently, we arrive at a TP of Rs 6,100/share, implying an upside of 27% from the CMP.
watch: Traction across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh further supports the growth outlook, with management expecting to surpass its earlier FY27 revenue growth guidance of 18–20%. • Margin Recovery Expected Through Pricing Actions: EBITDA margin declined 200 bps YoY to 12.2% in Q2FY27, primarily due to elevated brass and gas prices, higher outsourcing costs and discounts.
